first_step_test: A slightly leaning tapered cone with a rounded tip is recognizable on its own and leaves room beneath for a broad base.

source.notes: Contact sheet first; preserve failed iterations privately.

final_elements.name: leaning cone body
final_elements.description: A left-leaning tapered traffic-cone body with one rounded top and open bottom.

final_elements.name: broad square base
final_elements.description: A broad flat platform beneath the body with visible front and side edges.

final_elements.name: upper reflective stripe
final_elements.description: One broad curved stripe around the upper third of the cone.

final_elements.name: lower reflective stripe
final_elements.description: One broad curved stripe around the lower third of the cone.

final_elements.name: two base scuffs
final_elements.description: Two short angled wear marks on the front of the base.

final_elements.name: three wobble ticks
final_elements.description: Three short separate motion ticks beside the upper right side.

final_elements.name: broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: A short broken marker shadow just below the broad base.

frames.visible_job: Draw a tall taper leaning a little left, round its top, and leave its bottom open.
frames.instruction: Draw two gently uneven black marker lines tapering to a rounded tip that leans left. Leave the wide bottom open for the base.

frames.visible_job: Attach a wide low platform under the cone with a visible front edge and short side edges.
frames.instruction: Under the open bottom, draw a wide flat platform. Give it a narrow front face and short angled side edges so the leaning cone sits firmly.

frames.visible_job: Add one curved reflective band high and one lower on the cone without shifting the body.
frames.instruction: Across the tapered body, draw two wide curved bands: one below the rounded tip and one above the base. Let their ends touch the side outlines.

frames.visible_job: Add two short angled wear marks on the base's front face.
frames.instruction: On the base's front edge, mark two short angled scuffs. Keep them apart so the platform remains a single solid shape.

frames.visible_job: Place three short wobble ticks beside the upper right and a broken shadow beneath the base.
frames.instruction: Beside the upper right side, draw three short separate wobble ticks. Under the base, add a broken ground shadow that does not touch the cone.

final_step.visible_job: Fill the established cone orange, preserve two pale reflective bands, and color the base dark teal.
final_step.instruction: Fill the cone in streaky safety orange while leaving both reflective bands pale. Color the established base dark teal and deepen only its existing shadow and scuffs.
adds: orange and teal marker fill on established shapes
